column7: A panic in a post-verdict login storage write (MarkTOTPStepUsed on /auth/mfa/verify; CreateSession on /auth/login, /auth/mfa/verify, WebAuthn finish) reached the Recovery middleware: HTTP 500 where a wrong credential gets 401, lockout not counted, nothing audited. core mintLoginSession / markTOTPStepUsedAfterMatch now return the panic as the write's post-verdict error, commit-aware (a landed session row is deleted and no token returned; the consumed TOTP step is never given back after a panic). Also: server/http/handlers panic subtests through middleware.Recovery, internal/core TestLoginWritePanic_DeniedLikeItsError (incl. panic after commit).
